label: Racer
note: Issue #611: a speeder racer (content/core/racing/crews/*.json): a port local who hangs out with their crew by a desert place and races you for money. Their crew file sets each one's look (the local body with a guard helmet in the crew's colours) and speeder. Run by the crew's own Townsfolk (role 'local' with nowhere to walk): hurt one and the crew fights back; the town does not hear of it. Only the blocks below differ from local_resident.json. Voice: the racer pool (voice_profiles.json role_profiles 'racer', dark and aggressive voices, a stable pick each) with a menacing delivery, not the townsfolk's local pool; their fixed lines are recorded by tools/audio/make_voice_lines.py.
